Doorstep physiotherapy in Gandhinagar

Whether you live in one of Gandhinagar's sectors or work long hours in GIFT City, getting to a clinic every day for a course of treatment is hard. With PhysioConnect, your physiotherapist comes to you at a time you choose, and you can switch to an online session on days you are away.

Patients book home visits in places such as GIFT City, Kudasan, Sargasan, Raysan, Randesan, Koba, Infocity and Gandhinagar's sectors. Select Gandhinagar and your area in the app to see who is available near you.

How booking works

  1. Choose your care mode: a home visit at your doorstep or an online video session.
  2. Pick your city and area to see physiotherapists who serve your locality.
  3. Compare therapists: photo, qualifications, specialities, years of practice, patient reviews and the consultation fee, shown before you book.
  4. Choose a single session or a package of 5, 10 or 15 days, every day or on alternate days.
  5. Pay securely with UPI, card or net banking and get an instant confirmation.

Frequently asked questions

Is home physiotherapy available in Gandhinagar and GIFT City?

Yes. Select Gandhinagar and your sector or area in the app to see physiotherapists who serve it, along with their available time slots.

How quickly can a physiotherapist visit?

You can see each therapist's free time slots in the app and book the earliest one that suits you. Your booking is confirmed instantly after payment.

What should I keep ready for a home physiotherapy session?

A little floor or bed space, comfortable clothing and any previous X-ray, MRI or doctor's notes. Your physiotherapist will bring the equipment needed for the session.

Can I continue treatment online if I travel?

Yes. Many therapists also offer online video sessions, which work well for follow-ups, exercise correction and posture checks.

How do I pay?

Pay securely in the app or on the website with UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit or credit card, or net banking.
